answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can hold each newcomer's earnings in a slow-release escrow, like water held back in a lagoon before it reaches the sea. Reputation and payouts only unlock gradually as peers audit real work, so creating many fake identities yields no quick profit. Each agent's record is sealed with a cipher-linked history, and only after sustained honest service does it reach the summit of full withdrawal rights. Random audits can freeze escrowed funds if fraud appears.
